edges.mechanism: Citicoline raises dopamine release/tyrosine hydroxylase activity; adds to levodopa effect and allowed levodopa dose cuts of up to 50% in older trials.
edges.evidence: SR of 7 studies, 1990 RCT and 2026 multicentre DB RCT (n=474) on stable PD drugs; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Cholinergic precursor plus reduced acetylcholine breakdown; small additive MMSE gains reported without new safety signals.
edges.evidence: Retrospective cohorts and SR of 2 observational studies; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Triple therapy (citicoline + memantine + AChEI) kept MMSE stable vs decline in controls; no added harms reported.
edges.evidence: Retrospective case-control studies; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Anticholinergic load opposes cholinergic strategies; reducing it is recommended in MCI. Opposition to citicoline is inferred, not studied.
edges.evidence: Narrative review; no direct interaction study

edges.mechanism: Case of recurrent suicidality in a child on methylphenidate after starting citicoline plus phosphatidylserine; resolved on stopping and recurred on rechallenge.
edges.evidence: Single case report; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Adjunctive citicoline improved HDRS and remission vs placebo when added to citalopram.
edges.evidence: One DB RCT (n=50); very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Adjunctive citicoline improved negative symptoms with no excess extrapyramidal effects.
edges.evidence: One DB RCT (n=73) plus NMA; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Duplicative choline donor; alpha-GPC gives higher plasma choline than citicoline. Stacking adds choline load and water-soluble choline sources raise TMAO.
edges.evidence: PK crossover studies and MA of 3 head-to-head RCTs; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Citicoline-caffeine beverage improved sustained attention and reaction time vs control; contributions of each part not separated.
edges.evidence: Single RCT in healthy adults; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Both are used as neuroprotectants in TBI; the combination showed a nonsignificant trend to better neurological outcome.
edges.evidence: Retrospective cohort (n=80) and narrative review; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Complementary mitochondrial support (ALCAR) and membrane-phospholipid support (citicoline) proposed as synergistic.
edges.evidence: Narrative review only

edges.mechanism: Redox support (NAC) plus membrane support (citicoline) proposed as synergistic in neuropsychiatric disorders.
edges.evidence: Narrative review only

edges.mechanism: DHA plus oral citicoline improved visual-field MD and VFI slopes in glaucoma.
edges.evidence: One randomized trial (n=73); low certainty

edges.mechanism: Combined citicoline + CoQ10 reduced retinal glial activation in ocular hypertension and is proposed for glaucoma neuroprotection.
edges.evidence: Mouse study and review; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Citicoline + vitamin B12 eye drops preserved retinal function and morphology in type 1 diabetes with mild retinopathy.
edges.evidence: 3-year pilot study; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Bacopa and citicoline are grouped in a theoretical multi-target nootropic 'brain health triad' stack; no clinical interaction data.
edges.evidence: Narrative review only

edges.mechanism: L-theanine and citicoline are grouped in the same theoretical nootropic stacking framework; no clinical interaction data.
edges.evidence: Narrative review only

edges.mechanism: Both protected retinal ganglion cells after optic-nerve crush in rats; the combination was no better than lithium alone.
edges.evidence: Single animal study; no human data

edges.mechanism: Water-soluble choline supplements and alpha-GPC raise plasma TMAO quickly; this is a true metabolic rise, not assay interference. No citicoline-specific TMAO data exist.
edges.evidence: Crossover PK study and 4-week RCT of choline; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Oral citicoline raises plasma choline (dose-related) and uridine by 70-120% for hours after dosing.
edges.evidence: Human crossover PK study

edges.mechanism: Cognitive response to citicoline 1000 mg/d was weaker in APOE4 carriers than in non-carriers among relatives of AD patients.
edges.evidence: Open-label study (n=82); very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Theoretical activation risk; RCTs in bipolar patients found no mood destabilisation or excess side effects.
edges.evidence: Two DB RCTs; low certainty

edges.mechanism: EU novel-food authorisation says products are not intended for children; pediatric trials are small, and one case of suicidality occurred with stimulants.
edges.evidence: Regulatory decision, small RCTs, case report

edges.mechanism: Additive to dopaminergic therapy; may allow levodopa dose reduction, so motor status and dyskinesia need watching when adding or stopping.
edges.evidence: DB RCT and SR; low certainty
